root_cause: The generic live Statcast profile divided in-zone pitches by every source row, including rows whose zone was unavailable. Chase and zone parsing also lacked a shared fail-closed domain boundary.

repair.zone_rate_contract: zones 1-9 divided by all nonmissing classified zones 1-14
repair.missing_zone_policy: exclude from the zone-rate denominator; preserve the source row
repair.invalid_zone_policy: fail closed on nonnumeric nonmissing values or numeric values outside 1-14

historical_reconstruction.reason: The certified 2023/2024 direct batter panel already used all nonmissing classified zones as its denominator. Rebuilding it would relabel unchanged evidence and is prohibited.

chronological_evaluation.hr_over_0_5: NO_NEW_NUMERIC_CANDIDATE; preserved prior separate-market result and spent 2025 confirmation boundary

promotion.reason: The repair makes future source-to-feature consumption truthful but creates no fresh untouched performance evidence.

highest_value_next_action: Audit the player-summary Statcast barrel/hard-hit alias, count, denominator, and lineage contract before any such rate can enter future HR probabilities.
